语言切换功能已完成实现 (Language switcher feature implemented)! ✅

Changes in commit `243250e`:
- Added language switcher button to the documentation site
- Configured i18n provider with English ("English") and Chinese ("中文") options
- Language switching now works seamlessly between `/docs` (English) and `/cn/docs` (Chinese)

Screenshots showing the feature:
- **English version with switcher:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4e2b49ba-9c18-4bae-986c-27dde98aa644
- **Chinese version with switcher:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5fce241a-016f-4ba2-a768-7e427248bcbd  
- **Dropdown menu:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb329f19-750a-419c-9829-1782c1174578
@copilot 网站首页还缺少切换语言的入口，而且应该根据当前用户的语言自动跳转到对应的语言

> @copilot 继续

已完成两个功能的实现 (Both features implemented)! ✅

**1. 首页语言切换入口 (Homepage language switcher)** - Commit `494855a`:
- 在首页导航栏添加了语言切换按钮
- 与文档页面一样，支持英文和中文切换

**2. 自动语言检测 (Automatic language detection)**:
- 已通过 middleware 实现自动语言检测
- 根据浏览器语言设置自动跳转到相应语言版本
- 语言偏好会保存在 cookie 中

Homepage with language switcher:
![Homepage](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/98a0a0fa-e35d-4471-b5a4-1d26dd3a6af8)
